outcome_variable_scope: Whole-join own-minus-donor attribution against REAL HUMAN pairwise rankings, satisfaction from r04's tensor. Only the donor seed varies across the 120 draws -- same prompts, same rubrics, same responses, same judge, same rankings.
scope: This bounds the DONOR-DRAW component of a single-seed attribution number. It says nothing about the prompt-sampling component, which the bootstrap CIs already report and which is a different uncertainty. It also does not license averaging the two: they are separate resampling designs over separate objects.
verdict: R REALISATION. Every attribution number in this package -- r12's, r86's whole-join +0.1215 and its form split, r87's three arms -- comes from ONE donor draw under seed 20260727. The project has already had to retract three single-realisation results (r57, r69, r71), but all three were the response/criterion axis; the DONOR axis had never been checked, and it is the axis the headline rides on. r87 sharpened why: the free construction draws independently per prompt, so it samples WITH replacement -- a given draw uses 611 of 968 prompts as donors and about 357 never serve at all. Across 120 independent draws attribution is +0.1249 with sd 0.00550, range [+0.1121,+0.1375], central 95% [+0.1141,+0.1352]; the canonical seed sits -0.62 sd from the centre, an ordinary draw. JUDGED AGAINST THE THREE CONTRASTS NAMED BEFORE THE RUN: the donor-draw sd is 0.66x the deterministic-vs-random pairing offset; 0.98x the long-form vs short-form attribution gap; 0.47x the single-seed bootstrap CI half-width. So published donor-condition differences of this size are INSIDE the draw and cannot be read as structure. TWO UNCERTAINTIES, KEPT SEPARATE: the bootstrap CI beside every attribution number resamples PROMPTS at a fixed donor draw; this resamples DONOR DRAWS at a fixed prompt set. Neither contains the other and they are not combined here. THE ARITHMETIC FLOOR, stated before the run: a non-zero spread is guaranteed, so the question was never whether sd exceeds zero but whether it is large against what has been published -- and that is the comparison above. REBUILD CONTROL: seed 20260727 reproduces r86's stored value exactly, so this spread cannot be an artifact of a drifted re-implementation.
